description: This file defines the 'SavedNewsDb' class for managing local storage of news articles using SQLite in a Flutter app. It handles database initialization, inserting or updating ('upsert'), deleting by headline, and retrieving all saved news articles.

classes.name: SavedNewsDb
classes.description: A class for managing the local database of saved news articles, providing methods to initialize, insert or update, delete, and retrieve articles.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the database if it hasn't been initialized yet, including creating the 'News_Table' if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: _database
methods.description: Getter for the database instance; throws an error if the database has not been initialized.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts a new news article or replaces an existing one based on the primary key (headline).

methods.name: deleteByHeadline
methods.description: Deletes a news article from the database keyed by its headline.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all saved news articles ordered by most recent time.
